components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact Bootstrap action for operational commands and form submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0d6efd; color: #fff; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #0d6efd; border-radius: 0.375rem; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; transition: transform 0.2s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.3s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0b5ed7; border-color: #0a58ca; transform: scale(1.03); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0.2rem solid rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Social Channel Button
components.description: Destination-colored social action used in the branded title header.
components.css: .ds-social-button { display: inline-block; padding: 10px 20px; color: #fff; background: #2481cc; border-radius: 5px; text-decoration: none; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; transition: transform 0.2s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.3s ease-in-out, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-social-button:hover, .ds-social-button:focus-visible { color: #fff; background: #1a8ad5; transform: scale(1.03); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Image-first content unit for the home feed and related media surfaces.
components.css: .ds-content-card { overflow: hidden; background: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; color: #1f1f1f; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-content-card:hover { transform: scale(1.03); box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); } .ds-content-card__media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: #f1f1f1; } .ds-content-card__body { padding: 0.9rem 1rem 0.75rem; } .ds-content-card__body small { color: #6c757d; font: 700 0.75rem/1.2 Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-content-card__body h3 { margin: 0.35rem 0 0.5rem; font: 600 1.05rem/1.25 Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-content-card__body p { margin: 0; color: #555; font: 400 0.9rem/1.5 Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Bootstrap-compatible field for tools, forms, and account workflows.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; color: #1f1f1f; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.375rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; color: #212529; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: 0.375rem; font: inherit; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #86b7fe; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.25); }

components.name: Quick Link
components.description: Editorial directory row with icon or image, concise copy, and directional affordance.
components.css: .ds-quick-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.9rem; min-height: 4.5rem; padding: 1rem 1.1rem; color: #18232d; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78); border: 1px solid rgba(24, 35, 45, 0.12); border-radius: 0.5rem; box-shadow: 0 0.75rem 2rem rgba(24, 35, 45, 0.08); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-quick-link:hover, .ds-quick-link:focus-visible { border-color: #ab4b2c; box-shadow: 0 1rem 2.25rem rgba(24, 35, 45, 0.14); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-quick-link__icon { display: grid; flex: 0 0 2.5rem; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; place-items: center; border-radius: 0.35rem; color: #ab4b2c; background: #f1d8ca; font-size: 1.25rem; } .ds-quick-link__copy { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 0.15rem; } .ds-quick-link__copy small { overflow: hidden; color: #52616b; font-size: 0.82rem; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-quick-link__arrow { margin-left: auto; color: #ab4b2c; font-size: 1.2rem; }

narrative.overview:
MorWalPizVideo is a creative-operational video hub: the interface carries a visible creator identity while helping visitors scan content, reach social channels, manage tools, and follow live or scheduled activity. The main shell layers readable Bootstrap content over a photographic brand backdrop. Its signature wordmark uses the custom High Speed face, with oversized dark initials and pale supporting letters to create a compact, recognizable masthead.

The system is practical first, but it is not anonymous. Content cards, status alerts, filters, social actions, and forms use familiar Bootstrap patterns so repeated work stays predictable. The quick-links surface is a deliberate editorial variation: cool paper, sage, and terracotta create a calmer link directory while retaining the same direct, action-oriented rhythm.
keyCharacteristics: Branded photographic atmosphere behind a readable content layer.
Bootstrap utility language strengthened by custom creator branding.
Content-led cards with image-first 16:9 media and compact metadata.
Flat surfaces at rest, with restrained lift and shadow on interaction.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Social colors and terracotta should identify a destination or state; they should not become a general page wash.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use High Speed only for the brand mark; use Roboto for the application and Georgia only for the quick-links editorial headline.

rules.name: The State-Lift Rule
rules.body: Depth belongs to interaction and hierarchy: use shadow and translation to signal hover or focus, not as decoration on every surface.

dos: Do keep the High Speed typeface exclusive to the brand mark.
Do preserve 16:9 media framing for home content cards.
Do use saturated social colors only for the matching social destination.
Do keep operational surfaces readable over the photographic background.
Do let cards and quick links lift subtly on hover and focus-visible.
Do retain the quick-links sage, paper, and terracotta atmosphere on that route.
donts: Don't replace the photographic backdrop with a flat application-wide fill without an explicit identity decision.
Don't use High Speed for body copy, labels, or forms.
Don't turn every surface into a heavily rounded floating card.
Don't mix quick-links terracotta into unrelated Bootstrap status semantics.
Don't let responsive card grids distort media proportions or create horizontal overflow.
